newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy pensions head sees loss of 80,000 bank jobs.
newsitem.headline: Italy pensions head sees loss of 80,000 bank jobs.

text.p: The head of Italy's social security and pensions body INPS said he saw 80,000 of the 380,000 workers in the country's banking system losing their jobs due to the advances of new technology.
"No one is any longer able to stop job losses in such traditional sectors," Gianni Billia told reporters after a parliamentary hearing on early retirement.

"With new (technological) systems for example 80,000 bank workers out of 380,000 will have to go, and these will be particularly the front line employees, the counter tellers," he said. He gave no time-scale for his forecast.

He added that if these redundant staff were to seek early retirement "they will not be able to ask for solidarity contributions from other sectors of workers, the bank workers themselves will have to pay for their own early retirement."
